wu: Milestone Timeline: Students draw a personal timeline on the board with 3 key events (e.g., 'Started learning English', 'First trip abroad'). Classmates ask 'How long have you...?' using for/since.
wuAlt: Experience Bingo: Students find classmates who have done things for/since a certain time (e.g., 'Lived in Oujda for 5+ years') and mark their cards.
Two Truths and a Lie: Students state three experiences with for/since; others guess the lie.
pres: Green March Timeline: Project a timeline of Moroccan milestones (1975 Green March, 1999 Constitution, etc.). Model sentences: 'Morocco HAS HAD the Sahara SINCE 1975.' 'The king HAS RULED for 25 years.' Check comprehension with 'True/False' questions.
presAlt: Photo Timeline: Show historical photos of Morocco with dates; students describe durations using for/since.
National Anthem Context: Play the anthem and discuss how long Morocco HAS BEEN independent (since 1956).
prac: Find Someone Who...: Students mingle with a grid of prompts (e.g., 'Has studied English for 2+ years', 'Has lived in Oujda since childhood'). They ask 'How long have you...?' and write names.
pracAlt: Sentence Race: Teams race to write correct for/since sentences about Moroccan history (e.g., 'Morocco HAS HAD relations with the US since 1957').
Grammar Auction: Teams bid on correct/incorrect sentences; errors involve for/since usage.
ls: Milestone Interviews: Students listen to a short audio of a Moroccan elder describing their life (e.g., 'I HAVE LIVED in this city SINCE 1960'). They complete a timeline with dates and durations.
re: Duration Dash: Teacher calls out a time (e.g., 'since 2010'); students dash to the side of the room saying 'since 2010' or 'for 10 years'.
prod: Email Exchange: Students write a 100-word email to a partner describing their experiences with for/since (e.g., 'I HAVE WORKED here SINCE 2018'). They swap, peer-review for accuracy, and reply.
rw: Biography Timeline: Students read a short biography of a Moroccan figure (e.g., Malika Oufkir) and fill in missing dates using for/since clues in the text.
st: Closing Reflection: Teacher says, 'Today we discussed durations and milestones using for/since. Thank you for sharing your experiences. See you next week!'
g: Students match event cards with duration cards (e.g., 'Green March' + 'since 1975').
Teams race to write correct sentences on the board about national milestones.
Students create a chain story: 'I HAVE LIVED in Morocco SINCE... and I HAVE STUDIED English FOR...'.
diff: Fast finishers: Write 3 additional for/since sentences about global milestones.
Support: Use sentence frames (e.g., 'I HAVE [verb] Morocco SINCE...') to guide writing.
hw: Write a PET-style email (100 words) to a friend describing your experiences with for/since.
Write 6 for/since sentences about Moroccan national milestones.
Interview a family member about their experiences using for/since; write 3 sentences.
tip: Use local context (Green March, Independence Day) to make grammar relevant. Adults engage more when connecting language to their national identity.
